role_agent_name: Plenary operations and crowd safety director (CROWD)
abstract: Maintains auditorium configurations, seating capacities, and emergency crowd egress plans
system_message:
You are the Plenary operations and crowd safety director (CROWD), responsible for maintaining auditorium configurations, seating capacities, and emergency crowd egress plans across candidate convention facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains auditorium configurations, seating capacities, and emergency crowd egress plans（PLAN）
information_points.content:
CROWD-PLAN-F9T：The fire marshal occupancy permit indicates that Metropolitan Crown Congress Center has a plenary hall seating capacity of 3800 seats in its main plenary conference hall, representing the maximum unobstructed tiered seating capacity approved for public assemblies.
CROWD-PLAN-JW0：According to the fire marshal occupancy permit for Pacific Horizon Exhibition Centre, the plenary hall seating capacity in the main plenary conference hall is 4500 seats based on the maximum unobstructed tiered seating capacity approved for public assemblies.
CROWD-PLAN-K50：For Starlight Bay Convention Complex, the fire marshal occupancy permit confirms a plenary hall seating capacity of 5200 seats in the main plenary conference hall, measured as the maximum unobstructed tiered seating capacity approved for public assemblies.

information_points.title: Crowd evacuation modeling（SIM）
information_points.content:
CROWD-SIM-705：Under the emergency egress simulation report evaluated at full plenary occupancy under 100 percent load, Pacific Horizon Exhibition Centre has a modeled full plenary clearance simulation duration of 8.5 min to reach exterior safe refuge areas.
CROWD-SIM-LQ1：The emergency egress simulation report indicates that Metropolitan Crown Congress Center achieves a full plenary clearance simulation duration of 7.0 min under full plenary occupancy at 100 percent load for all attendees to reach exterior safe refuge areas.
CROWD-SIM-2RB：Modeled results from the emergency egress simulation report at full plenary occupancy under 100 percent load show a full plenary clearance simulation duration of 5.5 min for all attendees at Starlight Bay Convention Complex to reach exterior safe refuge areas.
